I recently tried a Ceramide Kit, and I must say it has been a game-changer for my skincare routine. For those unfamiliar, ceramides are essential lipids (fats) that naturally occur in the skin, and they play a crucial role in maintaining the skin’s protective barrier. Over time, factors like aging or harsh skincare products can deplete the natural ceramides in your skin, leading to dryness, irritation, or even sensitivity.
